# UpahJe.my

> Plain, sourced answers about technology for Malaysian small businesses, in English and Bahasa Melayu.

This site publishes short, citable articles. Every claim links to a source; every article states when those sources were checked. Prefer the canonical URL of each language version.

## Concept index

- [Definitions](https://upahje.my/en/articles/category/definitions): The words on a job post, a contract or a payslip, defined plainly. (6 articles)
- [Definisi](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/category/definitions): Istilah dalam iklan kerja, kontrak atau slip gaji, dijelaskan dengan mudah. (6 articles)
- [Buying guides](https://upahje.my/en/articles/category/buying-guides): How to scope, compare and pay for local tech work. (10 articles)
- [Panduan membeli](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/category/buying-guides): Cara menentu skop, membanding dan membayar kerja teknologi tempatan. (10 articles)
- [Side income](https://upahje.my/en/articles/category/side-income): Turning a skill into a second income, step by step. (1 article)
- [Pendapatan sampingan](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/category/side-income): Menukar kemahiran menjadi pendapatan kedua, langkah demi langkah. (1 article)

## English articles

- [CommandCode, OpenCode, DeepSeek: what the published numbers actually measure](https://upahje.my/en/articles/commandcode-opencode-deepseek-numbers): No leaderboard runs CommandCode or OpenCode as the agent. SWE-bench and Terminal-bench score a model inside someone else's harness, so a head-to-head between two CLIs is a category error.
- [What an AI agent can and cannot do for a Malaysian SME](https://upahje.my/en/articles/what-an-ai-agent-can-do): An AI agent runs a loop on its own: it reads a task, calls tools, checks the result and repeats. What that covers unattended, what needs a human signature, and what no agent should touch.
- [What e-Invoice automation covers, and what stays with a person](https://upahje.my/en/articles/what-einvoice-automation-covers): Since 1 January 2026 every band is in force, and the RM3m to RM5m gap is in scope. What an automated submission does, what the 72-hour window changes, and which decisions no tool should take.
- [Agent harness, AI harness, agent framework: what the words mean](https://upahje.my/en/articles/agent-harness-vs-ai-harness): An agent harness runs the agent loop: it executes tool calls, holds the transcript, applies permissions. Vendors say agent harness. AI harness is not a term they use. A table of who says what.
- [Agent harnesses ranked: four CLIs installed on one machine](https://upahje.my/en/articles/agent-harnesses-ranked): DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, Codex CLI and OpenCode installed on one machine, scored 1-5 on five weighted criteria using only what we could read from each on 19 November 2026.
- [What automation work costs in Malaysia: published rates, six sources](https://upahje.my/en/articles/automation-rates-malaysia-published): Four Malaysian studios, one independent practitioner and one freelance profile: 30 published prices for automation and integration work, checked 19 November 2026 except one page read on 27 October 2026. Several source pages carry no publication date, so a price may be older than this article.
- [Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok: what actually differs between the closed models](https://upahje.my/en/articles/closed-models-differences): Not the benchmark score, which no current leaderboard here can settle. What you are stuck with: context window, price per token and the documented capabilities. Every cell sourced or marked not captured, and where the terms pages were not opened, the article says so.
- [Do you need an API, or just a spreadsheet?](https://upahje.my/en/articles/do-you-need-an-api-or-a-spreadsheet): A spreadsheet wins at low volume with one owner; an API wins when two systems must stay in sync without anyone copying. The three cases where a sheet is right, and the four signals it has stopped scaling.
- [Where your API key goes in a harness, and where it must never go](https://upahje.my/en/articles/harness-api-keys): A harness reads your key from an environment variable or its credential store when it calls the provider. What the key authenticates, the four places it must never appear, and what to do when it leaks.
- [Agent harnesses: who makes them, and what is actually open source](https://upahje.my/en/articles/harness-landscape-open-closed): Grok Bot and Dots are closed hosted products. OpenBot and MausBot are source-available projects, and only one of them is open source on its own licence. A table with the licence and the evidence level on every row.
- [How to brief an automation job so you don't pay twice](https://upahje.my/en/articles/how-to-brief-an-automation-job): Five things a freelancer needs before quoting, a reusable brief template, and the acceptance test to agree before work starts. Written for a Malaysian SME buying automation for the first time.
- [Open-weight models: Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral and Kimi, and what the licence lets you do](https://upahje.my/en/articles/open-models-differences): Four open-weight families, five model cards, four licence shapes. MIT on DeepSeek, a custom Qwen licence, Mistral's own open-weight licence. What each permits and what the model costs to rent.
- [Open or closed models: what a Malaysian SME can actually run in-house](https://upahje.my/en/articles/open-vs-closed-models-malaysia): An open-weight model can be downloaded and run on hardware you control. What that costs per month in Malaysia, the volume where it beats paying per call, and the skills it needs.
- [What RM100 a month buys you in AI, in Malaysia](https://upahje.my/en/articles/rm100-budget): RM100 is either a seat in a subscription app or a meter of API tokens, never both. The conversion at Bank Negara's 19 November 2026 rate, three worked usage levels, and the line where tokens win.
- [Five side-income skills in Malaysia that actually pay in 2026](https://upahje.my/en/articles/side-income-skills-malaysia-2026): Five skills clear a two-listing bar on the one Malaysian freelance platform whose public pages could be read: video editing, graphic design, data entry, cold calling and app testing. Rates, counts and dates from 11 listings.
- [What an agent harness is, and what it does with your request](https://upahje.my/en/articles/using-the-harness): A harness sits between you and the model: it holds the conversation, runs the tools, sends each request and streams the answer. What one message looks like inside DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1.
- [What is an API, explained for a Malaysian small business owner](https://upahje.my/en/articles/what-is-an-api-for-malaysian-sme): An API is a contract that lets two systems exchange data without a human copying it across. What it means for a Malaysian SME, open versus closed models, and the real cost of wiring one up.

## Bahasa Melayu articles

- [Apa yang AI agent boleh dan tidak boleh buat untuk PKS Malaysia](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/apa-yang-agent-boleh-buat): AI agent menjalankan gelung sendiri: ia membaca tugasan, memanggil tool, menyemak hasil dan mengulang. Apa yang diliputi tanpa penyeliaan, apa yang perlukan tandatangan manusia, dan apa yang tidak patut disentuh.
- [Apa yang diliputi automasi e-Invoice, dan apa yang kekal dengan manusia](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/apa-yang-automasi-e-invoice-liputi): Sejak 1 Januari 2026 semua fasa berkuat kuasa, dan jurang RM3 juta hingga RM5 juta termasuk dalam skop. Apa yang dilakukan oleh penyerahan automatik, apa yang diubah oleh tetingkap 72 jam, dan keputusan mana yang tidak patut diambil oleh tool.
- [CommandCode, OpenCode, DeepSeek: apa sebenarnya yang diukur oleh angka yang diterbitkan](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/commandcode-opencode-deepseek-angka): Tiada papan pendahulu menjalankan CommandCode atau OpenCode sebagai agent. SWE-bench dan Terminal-bench menilai model di dalam harness orang lain, jadi perbandingan antara dua CLI ialah kesilapan kategori.
- [Agent harness, AI harness, agent framework: apa maksud istilah ini](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/agent-harness-atau-ai-harness): Agent harness menjalankan gelung agent: ia melaksanakan tool call, menyimpan transkrip, menguatkuasakan kebenaran. Vendor menulis agent harness. AI harness bukan istilah yang mereka guna.
- [Apa itu agent harness, dan apa yang dilakukannya dengan permintaan anda](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/apa-itu-agent-harness): Harness berada antara anda dan model: ia menyimpan perbualan, menjalankan tools, menghantar permintaan dan menstrim jawapan. Rupa satu mesej di dalam DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1.
- [Apa itu API, dijelaskan untuk pemilik perniagaan kecil Malaysia](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/apa-itu-api-untuk-pks-malaysia): API ialah kontrak antara dua sistem untuk bertukar data tanpa perlu ada orang menyalinnya. Apa maksudnya bagi PKS, beza model terbuka dengan tertutup, dan kos sebenar menyambungkannya.
- [Apa yang RM100 sebulan beli dalam AI, di Malaysia](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/bajet-rm100-ai-malaysia): RM100 ialah sama ada satu tempat duduk dalam aplikasi langganan, atau satu meter token API, bukan kedua-duanya. Penukaran pada kadar Bank Negara 19 November 2026, tiga tahap penggunaan, dan garis di mana token menang.
- [Model terbuka: Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral dan Kimi, dan apa yang dibenarkan oleh lesennya](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/beza-model-terbuka): Empat keluarga terbuka, lima kad model, empat bentuk lesen. MIT pada DeepSeek, lesen Qwen tersuai, lesen terbuka Mistral sendiri. Apa yang dibenarkan dan kos menyewanya.
- [Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini dan Grok: apa sebenarnya beza antara model tertutup](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/beza-model-tertutup): Bukan skor penanda aras, yang tiada papan pendahulu semasa dapat dipastikan di sini. Apa yang anda terikat dengannya: tetingkap konteks, harga setiap token dan keupayaan yang didokumenkan. Setiap sel bersumber atau ditanda tidak dirakam, dan jika halaman terma tidak dibuka, artikel menyatakannya.
- [Cara menulis brief kerja automasi supaya anda tidak bayar dua kali](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/cara-tulis-brief-kerja-automasi): Lima perkara yang freelancer perlukan sebelum memberi sebut harga, templat brief yang boleh diguna semula, dan ujian penerimaan yang perlu dipersetujui sebelum kerja bermula.
- [Harness agent disusun: empat CLI yang dipasang pada satu mesin](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/harness-agent-disusun): DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, Codex CLI dan OpenCode dipasang pada satu mesin, dinilai 1-5 pada lima kriteria berwajaran menggunakan hanya apa yang dapat kami baca daripada setiap satu pada 19 November 2026.
- [Kos kerja automasi di Malaysia: harga yang diterbitkan, enam sumber](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/kos-automasi-malaysia-harga-diterbitkan): Empat studio Malaysia, satu pengamal bebas dan satu profil freelance: 30 harga diterbitkan untuk kerja automasi dan integrasi, disemak 19 November 2026 kecuali satu halaman dibaca pada 27 Oktober 2026. Beberapa halaman sumber tiada tarikh terbitan, jadi sesuatu harga mungkin lebih lama daripada artikel ini.
- [Di mana kunci API anda diletakkan dalam harness, dan di mana ia tidak boleh ada](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/kunci-api-dalam-harness): Harness membaca kunci anda daripada pemboleh ubah persekitaran atau stor credentialsnya apabila memanggil pembekal. Apa yang disahkan kunci itu, empat tempat ia tidak boleh muncul, dan apa yang perlu dibuat apabila ia bocor.
- [Harness agent: siapa yang membuatnya, dan apa yang benar-benar sumber terbuka](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/landskap-harness-agent-sumber-terbuka): Grok Bot dan Dots ialah produk tertutup yang dihoskan. OpenBot dan MausBot ialah projek sumber tersedia, dan hanya satu daripadanya sumber terbuka pada lesennya sendiri. Jadual dengan lesen dan tahap bukti pada setiap baris.
- [Lima kemahiran pendapatan sampingan di Malaysia yang benar-benar membayar pada 2026](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/lima-kemahiran-pendapatan-sampingan-2026): Lima kemahiran melepasi syarat dua senarai pada satu-satunya platform freelance Malaysia yang halaman awamnya boleh dibaca: suntingan video, reka bentuk grafik, kemasukan data, panggilan jualan dan ujian aplikasi. Kadar, kiraan dan tarikh daripada 11 senarai.
- [Model terbuka atau tertutup: apa yang mampu dijalankan sendiri oleh PKS Malaysia](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/model-terbuka-atau-tertutup-pks-malaysia): Model terbuka boleh dimuat turun dan dijalankan pada perkakasan sendiri. Berapa kosnya sebulan, bila ia mula berbaloi berbanding bayaran ikut panggilan, dan kemahiran yang diperlukan.
- [Perlukan API, atau cukup spreadsheet?](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/perlu-api-atau-cukup-spreadsheet): Spreadsheet menang pada jumlah kecil dengan satu pemilik; API menang apabila dua sistem perlu selaras tanpa ada orang menyalin. Tiga keadaan spreadsheet betul, dan empat tanda ia sudah tidak memadai.

## Notes

- Each article lists its sources and the date they were checked.
- Draft articles are not published and are not listed here.
- English and Malay versions are separate, human-written pages linked by hreflang.
